anime_multiverse.skill.msg.argonaut.migr: Firebolt is now a mode of Argonaut.
anime_multiverse.skill.msg.argonaut.rest: Firebolt is its own skill again.
anime_multiverse.skill.heros_argonaut.de: Ultimate. Evolved from Argonaut. Charge up to ten bells and strike with triple power, or release the charge as a piercing Hero's Beam, both burning what they hit. A third mode fires Firebolt.
anime_multiverse.skill.argonaut.descript: Unique. The wish to become a hero. Hold to charge with the chime of bells (up to five) and release to strike everything in front of you, setting it alight. A second mode fires Firebolt: the instant you press, a bolt of lightning-fire.
anime_multiverse.skill.firebolt.descript: Instant magic. A bolt of lightning-fire fired the moment you press, striking what you look at and scorching everything near it. Mastery doubles the damage. Argonaut now holds this as a mode; this skill stays for old saves.
